PrivacyLens / A CCST9003 concept in progressBuilt for thoughtful sharing.
BEHIND THE PROTOTYPE

Privacy depends on context.

PrivacyLens explores a simple question: can choosing the recipient and purpose help students share useful screenshots with less unnecessary disclosure?

Working in this version

Two sharing scenarios, pre-labelled sample recommendations, local OCR, optional AI text classification, editable masks and flattened PNG export.

Still to be evaluated

Model accuracy, bounding-box precision, broader screenshot types and evaluation with students. Model suggestions need your review.

课堂演示建议 / Demo guide

示例默认使用预设坐标。可先在本机运行 OCR，再主动同意发送识别文字给 gpt-6-luna 分类；图片不发送。公开分享遮挡建议字段；客服场景仅建议保留订单号与运单号。二维码、条形码和人脸需手动补框。检查漏检后再导出。

All sample personal details are fictional. Editing and OCR run on this device. AI text classification sends recognized text and layout through this site's server to its configured provider (default: ai.novacode.top), only with your consent. Images are not sent by this workflow. OCR models load from this site. Text and images are not stored by the app; model assets may be cached by your browser. This app does not save images or results; provider and hosting data policies apply. Suggestions do not guarantee that every sensitive detail is covered.
